units: <cite ref="Shabbat 105a:2">Sabb. 105ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>א̇ב̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 17:5">Gen. XVII, 5</cite>) I have made thee <he>א̇ב</he> a father of the nations, <he>ב̇' נתתיך וכ׳</he> I have made thee a chosen one among the nations.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76">Gen. R. s. 76</cite>, beg.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:16">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>ב׳ ובתולה מיכן</he> a young man and a virgin on the one side (of the coin).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71:10">Gen. R. s. 71</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>בַּחוּרִים</he>, f. <he>בַּחוּרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:25">Num. R. s. 10</cite>, beg. <he>לב׳ קול וכ׳</he> to the young (the strong) ‘the voice of the Lord (at revelation) sounded with might’, opp. <he>תשים</he>; a. e.
